# v0.10.5 - Windows Names Windows Cannot Open

## What's Changed in v0.10.5

A fixes-only release (soft maintenance mode): two Windows bugs found by a bug hunt (names Windows cannot open, a source typed with the extended-length prefix), a test-harness fix, and the plan for v0.11 written down. Each fix has a test that fails without it.

### Fixed
- **Windows: a source holding a name Windows cannot open no longer stops the snapshot.** A tree that came from Linux, an archive or a share can hold `CON`, `aux.txt`, `dir.` or a folder whose name ends in a space; `git add` stopped the whole run on the first one. These paths are now left out and named in a `Warning:` (rename them to have them captured); the rest of the tree is snapshotted.
- **Windows: a source typed with the extended-length prefix (`--source \\?\C:\data`) no longer ends in a traceback.**

### Changed
- The project is in soft maintenance mode (`CONTRIBUTING.md`), and `UPGRADING.md` says what v0.11 will break and that the newest 0.10 release is the last one (no backports).

### Upgrading

Nothing about what is stored changes and no setting is renamed. See "Upgrading to v0.10.5" in `UPGRADING.md`.

The full list is in `CHANGELOG.md`.
